records.place: Saltaire
records.summary: At the outbreak of war, Germany and Russia cancelled outstanding yarn contracts with Salts Mill. The collection reports that these two markets together had accounted for 90% of exported yarn; the mill moved to short-time working.

source.locator: 1910s: James Roberts’ interests in Russia; paragraph on cancelled contracts at outbreak of war in 1914

records.spatialCaveat: UNESCO Saltaire property representative point; no factory footprint or shipping route implied.
